title: "[BUG]"

---

**Describe the bug**
Provide a clear and concise statement of what the bug entails. Doing so will result in me getting to the issue faster. Make sure to provide logs.

**To Reproduce**
I need steps on how to reproduce the behavior. Without it, I have to dig around and locate the issue.
Good example:
1) Go to "..."
2) Click/Place on "..."
3) Step on/Break "..."
4) See issue...

**Expected Behavior**
Provide a clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Version**
Include the version that Minecraft is on, version of the Modloader, and version of the mod you downloaded

**Compatibility**
Is this a conflict with another mod? Provide the details on what compatibility issue this is.

1) What mod may be causing the issue
2) Did removing that mod fix the issue
